_doc: MuJoCo friction = [sliding mu, torsional (m), rolling (m)]. Rolling = Crr x wheel radius (0.0325). Torsional ~ mu x 5 mm effective contact-patch radius (assumed). All values are ASSUMED engineering estimates, not measurements of Jaime's floors; run sensitivity sweeps (scenarios.py does mu 0.4-1.0 for the spin test). Measure with a tilt test: tan(slip angle) of a wheel-loaded sled on each floor.

sources.sliding: assumed: rubber on dry hard surface 0.6-0.85 (Engineering ToolBox, rubber/concrete dry, https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/friction-coefficients-d_778.html); 0.8 for clean laminate/vinyl/tile
sources.rolling: assumed: Crr ~0.015 rubber on hard floor (robot drive sizing guides, e.g. https://toolsphere.in/blog/robot-drive-motor-torque-sizing) x r

sources.sliding: assumed: low-pile carpet tile vs rubber tyre 0.5-0.7 (no primary source found; MEASURE)
sources.rolling: assumed: Crr ~0.05 on carpet (same sizing guide) x r
